comment: Shared by the managed Service tests and the Rust domain tests. Cases drive ProfileAutomationState; intent rows drive UpdateProfilesAsync. Each edit is [path, value] over base. A case's projectUnclassified is the runtime's ProjectUnclassifiedIntent, passed to Resolve as its observed source; its supportsManualFansOnLimitedPower (default true) is the device capability Resolve reads; its confirmed is the ConfirmedDeviceState Resolve reads (default all null). Each step's profile is the profile Resolve starts from: ApplicationProfileResolution.Apply over the base and the override it selects, or on ExternalUnknown CreateObservedFallbackProfile. Its intent is Resolve with no manual override, less the temporary full charge. An update step's intentChanged is UpdateProfilesAsync's activeApplicationIntentChanged expression over that Resolve. Regenerate the expectations and base with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS; never edit them by hand.
